title: $B_3$ in the Descartes universe: rationale
html: The volume axiom forces the gauge group to be a quantum form of \mathrm{SU}(2) (SU(2) emergence), independently of the Descartes condition; \mathrm{SU}(2) has rank 1. Consequently, the fundamental representation V is 2-dimensional. On V^{\otimes 2}, the braiding provides a single operator c_{V,V}. The first non-trivial braid group action occurs on V^{\otimes 3}, where the two generators \sigma_1, \sigma_2 of B_3 act via the categorical braid representation.
